verdict.rationale: The pack shows no dedicated export or backup feature. Data can only be pulled out programmatically: Atlassian advertises 'Rich APIs', and community users describe running REST queries against Jira data and writing API scripts, which implies a self-built extraction route. missing for 10: a documented full-data export or backup feature, named open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/XML), coverage of all data types including attachments and history, migration or offboarding guidance, independent confirmation that a complete export is possible.
